thread.title: Novice Trade: XLK Technology Sector ETF

title: Novice Trade: XLK Technology Sector ETF
text:
Novice Trade: XLK Technology Sector ETF By | Jun 26, 2018 | 8:30 AM EDT
The Trade: buy 1 XLK August 71 call for 1.00 point. The Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF's (XLK) holdings are primarily those of the biggest companies, names such as Apple (AAPL) , IBM (IBM) , Facebook (FB) , Google (GOOGL) , Intel (INTC) and Microsoft (MSFT) . Those stellar companies comprise almost half of the holdings of XLK. XLK has gained about 8% so far this year. That gain stands out when measured against the less than 2% gain so far for the S&P 500. The ETF has gained 25% over the past 52 weeks, and its trading range over this timeframe shows a low of $52.25 and a high of $72.43. Note that much of the past 52 weeks has seen the general market being rather volatile for price and value. These XLK big-tech companies are replete with fundamentally sound balance sheets and good-to-excellent earnings growth potential. As well, these companies are benefiting from the cut in the corporate tax rate.
Technically, I read XLK's one year chart as having formed into my washout pattern. That is a bullish pattern that sets up after a stock or ETF has come under heavy short-term liquidation in which it is highly likely that most upside resistance is no longer an impediment as the weak hands have sold out and the shorts have either covered or are far less likely to sell at that price and time....122
